text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару runs over to me,
beaming
enthusiastically!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Reverse fortune-telling time! The hour
has finally
dawned upon us, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm usually the one doing the
fortune-telling,
right? But this time
around, I bring an opportunity
so
incredible it's going to blow your mind!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I want you to tell my future.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Please, do me the honor! How do you
think my
race this afternoon will turn
out?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Predicting the future is not in my
repertoire, but
before I can say
anything...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I think...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text: I had a vision of Fukukitaru's future...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text:
I jump as a voice practically materializes
next to
us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wha?! Oh, Манхэттен Кафе!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Ever enigmatic and mysterious... Do you
walk the
boundary between this world
and the next even
now?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And did you just say you had a vision?
And that
vision was about my future?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Um... Well, sort of...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text: You appeared in my dream last night...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text: I did?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
So, what did you see? Surely a dream
from
someone as mysterious as yourself
will proffer
some sort of clue for me.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Whatever it is, I'd love to hear it!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: ...Okay.
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text:
Well, we were at today's scrimmage...
and you...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text:
I have a bad feeling about this. I take
Manhattan
Cafe aside to speak to her in
private.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru came in last place in my
dream...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text:
She was swallowed up by a mysterious
shadow
chasing her from behind...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text:
I knew it'd be bad... How should we
break the
news to her?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey! Traineeer. Cafeee. You can't just
keep all
the deets to yourselves.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Fill me in! What happened to me in your
dream?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: You blew the competition out of the water.

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what did you just say?! Is that true,
Cafe?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I finished dead last?! As in I didn't even
stand a
chance?! Not even a chance of...
chance of... the
chupacabra?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Yes... you were trapped by a black
shadow... It
caught you from behind...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text: Ain'tnoway! But considering it's your dream, there must be some truth to it...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
If I get caught by the chupacabra, it's
over for
me...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Later, at the scrimmage...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Outta my way! No way I'm letting myself
get
gobbled up!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! Fukukitaru?! What's got you so

flustered...
text_block_list.name: Leading Racer

text_block_list.text:
You better run fast, or you'll get eaten
by the
chupacabra too! That
blood-sucking fiend!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: What?! What are you talking about?!
text_block_list.name: Leading Racer

text_block_list.text:
I won?! And not only that, I blew
everyone out of
the water?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Great fortune must be coming my way,

Cafe-guaranteed!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I don't see any reason
not to go
wild. I have nothing to be
scared of anymore!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, pull in the victory haul!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
She's starting to put pressure on the
runner in the
lead. It looks like her
anxiety is giving her a
boost.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I ended up lying to her, but
Matikanefukukitaru's
complete faith in
the omen empowers her to
secure a huge
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
